# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in InvoicePlane V2, we kindly ask that you report it responsibly.

Please **do not disclose the issue publicly** until we have had a chance to investigate and release a patch.

### Contact

To report a vulnerability, email us at:

**[mail@invoiceplane.com](mailto:mail@invoiceplane.com)**

We will respond as quickly as possible and keep you informed throughout the resolution process.
